The [[Salving Cactus]] are [[Plant]] [[Monk]]s found in various parts of the [[Crystal Desert]]. Unlike most others of their species, the Salving Cactus will [[popup]] at random intervals, instead of only when [[aggro]]ed. They will continue this behavior until killed.

== Notes ==

* As with any [[popup]], you must kill them to get credit for [[vanquishing]] the area only ''if'' they appear. However, they can sometimes appear after you pass their location, requiring you to backtrack to locations that you thought you had cleared.
